title: OmniContext Test Suite Registry
description: The authoritative list of test suites: where their tests live, the framework, and how to run them. Merged with auto-detected suites when `omni graph build` writes the assurance layer.

paths.description: Files, directories or globs. Every source file under them becomes a test in the graph, whatever it is named.

covers.description: Code paths this suite is meant to cover.
